diagnostics.resultRequirements: Enter an actual result (1-2000 characters after trimming), not Pending, NA, N/A or Not yet added. Unit: up to 50 characters; optional reference range: up to 200. Select a flag explicitly.
diagnostics.discardExplanation: The server rejected this action (400/422). Discard it to stop retries and allow a corrected entry. The original action remains in the audit history.
diagnostics.discardedAudit: Discarded after server rejection. Audit retained; this action will not be replayed and no longer blocks a corrected entry.
diagnostics.discardFailed: Could not discard the rejected action. It remains unchanged; try again. A corrected entry is still blocked.
diagnostics.ordersUnavailable: Orders could not be refreshed. Any visible orders are the last loaded server snapshot.
diagnostics.catalogUnavailable: The backend test catalogue is unavailable or empty. Creating orders is disabled until it loads.
diagnostics.clinicianReview: Results and flags are entered by staff and require clinician review. This screen does not validate clinical rules.
diagnostics.criticalWarning: Critical result entered. Contact the responsible clinician immediately; saving to the queue does not notify them.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics

inventory.roleRequired: Only the PHARMACIST role can access inventory.
inventory.sourceNotice: Enter the backend facility ID to load stock. Counts shown are server snapshots, not verified physical counts.
inventory.unavailable: Inventory could not be loaded. Check the facility ID and connection; changes are disabled until a successful reload.
inventory.recordedUsage: Recorded dispensing in the last 7 days
inventory.usageNotice: Based only on retained local dispensing logs, including pending and failed sync entries. Not a complete usage history or stockout forecast.
inventory.countNotice: Enter the actual counted quantity. This queues a stock correction, not a verification or receipt confirmation.
inventory.title: Medicine Inventory

asha.roleRequired: Only the ASHA role can access home visits.
asha.scheduleNotice: Filters use the recorded trimester and next visit date from the backend. Missing dates are shown as unknown; no clinical visit schedule is inferred.
asha.unavailable: Patients could not be loaded. Retry when connected.
asha.noAncData: No patients with a recorded trimester were returned. ANC details may be unavailable from this backend.
asha.clinicianReview: This checklist and its review prompts are not clinically validated rules or a diagnosis. A clinician must review observations; unflagged entries do not establish safety.
asha.invalidChecklist: Record at least one observation or note. Use BP as systolic/diastolic (120/80) and positive numbers for weight, Hb and fundal height.
asha.hbReview: Hb below 11 g/dL entered: clinician review needed.
asha.bpReview: BP at or above 140 systolic or 90 diastolic entered: clinician review needed.
asha.presentationReview: Presentation recorded: ask a clinician to review. Presentation alone does not establish preterm labour.
asha.noAutoReferral: No referral or clinician notification is sent automatically. Arrange review directly when needed. Saving does not change the server visit schedule.
asha.title: ASHA Home Visit
asha.noDuePatients: No ANC patients due for visit

fieldSync.title: Saved local actions
fieldSync.explanation: Saved actions are not server-confirmed until synced. Unsupported actions remain pending or in error; do not re-enter them to retry.
fieldSync.saveFailed: Could not persist this action. Your form is still open; retry saving. No success was confirmed.
